regions.explanation: From 21.30s to 25.04s (“all religions and of all colors, from every”), articulation rate was 6.47 syll/s against 3.99 syll/s in the reference (+62%); that is 1.9× the reference speaker's natural word-to-word variation. Faster articulation compresses the stressed syllables and the micro-pauses listeners use to segment phrases, so key words lose emphasis and comprehension drops. Fix: Slow to the reference pace here and let the pauses between clauses breathe.
